tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The base colour of the ground, under the field. Cool grey in light, near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Sheets, cards, menus and dialogs. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, ink-subtle.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code and diff blocks and text fields. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Map cards, and a layer above surface in dark themes.

tokens.name: surface-popup
tokens.usage: Pop-ups: menus, select lists, popovers, dialogs and the Agents sheet. In dark it is a step lighter than the sheet and the cards, so a pop-up stands apart. With shadow-popup.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, and the edge of an unchanged card. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of controls and fields, the sheet grabber. 3:1 or more on surface and canvas.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every ground in this table.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, captions, the comparison line. 4.5:1 on canvas and surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Line numbers, unchanged status, placeholder text. 4.5:1 on canvas and surfaces; never below 12px.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Actions, the selection, the agent's card and added code. The one accent: teal.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: The ground of a selected row or chip. Text on it: ink or accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (the primary button).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring. 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: added
tokens.usage: Added code and files. The same teal as the accent: one colour fewer.

tokens.name: added-tint
tokens.usage: The ground of an added diff line. Text on it stays ink.

tokens.name: added-word
tokens.usage: The ground of the added words inside an added diff line.

tokens.name: removed
tokens.usage: Removed status: the − glyph, counts and the removed edge (dashed). Always with the − glyph.

tokens.name: removed-tint
tokens.usage: The ground of a removed diff line. Text on it stays ink.

tokens.name: removed-word
tokens.usage: The ground of the removed words inside a removed diff line.

tokens.name: modified
tokens.usage: Modified status: the ~ glyph and counts. Always with the ~ glyph.

tokens.name: modified-tint
tokens.usage: The ground of a modified row when a ground is needed.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rule breaks and destructive actions (Deny, Undo merge). Always with the broken-link icon or a verb.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: The ground of a rule-break line in the sheet.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention: a task that waits for the owner, a failed check that is not a rule break.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Approved, merged and passed. Always with a check icon or a word.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Dependency lines on the map.

tokens.name: card-line
tokens.usage: The thin light rim of a glass map card. It is decorative: a card is identified by its name and its frost, and the selected card has a 2px accent ring.

tokens.name: card-rim
tokens.usage: The top edge of a glass map card (the same as card-line).

tokens.name: float-line
tokens.usage: The thin light rim of glass: the map frame, the sheet and floating layers. It is decorative: glass stands out by its frost, its top highlight and its shadow.

tokens.name: sheet-edge
tokens.usage: The top edge of the review sheet.

tokens.name: layer-1
tokens.usage: The upper stratum under a changed folder card (ochre in light, teal in dark). Never a status.

tokens.name: layer-1-line
tokens.usage: The outline of layer-1.

tokens.name: layer-2
tokens.usage: The lower stratum under a changed folder card (rust in light, deep teal in dark). Never a status.

tokens.name: layer-2-line
tokens.usage: The outline of layer-2.

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: Strings in source and diffs. Code keywords use the accent; names and types use ink.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted glass: the map frame and large floating layers, with blur-glass. Lighter at the top, like light on glass.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: The review sheet and the composer: frosted glass that text can sit on.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: The colour field behind the glass (Tide). It is sky blue at the top and deep teal at the bottom, with a small warm glow in one corner. Soft shapes with eased stops and fine grain (frontend/grain.png) hide every edge and step. Use it on the page ground only, never on a part.

tokens.name: glass-card
tokens.usage: A changed map card: frosted glass with blur-card. Lines behind it blur.

tokens.name: glass-card-quiet
tokens.usage: An unchanged map card: a thin frost that fades into the frame.

tokens.name: glass-control
tokens.usage: A frosted button, chip or field on glass: a flat, clear fill, so the colour behind it shows through. No gradient.

tokens.name: glass-control-on
tokens.usage: The open tab or the selected segment: a little more frost than its groove. White frost in light, a faint teal frost in dark, so it takes the colour of the field.

tokens.name: glass-groove
tokens.usage: The track of tabs and segmented controls, and the ground of a text field: a faint frost, never a dark well.

tokens.name: accent-glass
tokens.usage: The one primary action (Send, Start task): the flat accent. Its top highlight comes from shadow-control.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a modal dialog (merge, commit, agents). Never behind the non-modal review sheet.

tokens.name: brand-mint
tokens.usage: Peek's top layer. Brand art only (Peek, the cover, the app icon); never an interface colour.

tokens.name: brand-sand
tokens.usage: Peek's middle layer. Brand art only; never an interface colour.

tokens.name: brand-clay
tokens.usage: Peek's bottom layer. Brand art only; never an interface colour.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: The ground of the app icon tile. Brand art only.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: The repository name in the header. One for each screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The title of a page or a dialog.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: The selection's name in the sheet, and the line of an empty state.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: The title of a page in the sheet (Tasks, a task, Proposed rules). One for each view.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The selection's name in the sheet, a row's main line, a section heading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The agent changed 4 files in backend/.
styles.usage: Reading text: Ask answers, instructions, task notes, and every text field (16px stops iOS zoom).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Rows, lists, details and the second line of a row. The workhorse size.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, segmented controls and card names on the map.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines and counts. The smallest text size: nothing is smaller than 12px.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: One key number with its unit, in the display family: 2 files, 6 min.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Source and diff lines, commands and rule JSON.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Commit hashes, paths and line numbers in meta lines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label; the gap inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related items in a row; between a title and its caption.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on the map; between rows of a dense list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The page gutter, sheet padding and the gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections of a sheet page.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Around an empty state; before the primary action at the end of a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Map spacing between sibling cards at the folder level.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline marks: code highlights and kbd keys.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, chips, code blocks and rows with a fill.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Map cards, menus, popovers and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The map frame and the top corners of the review sheet.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circles and pills: icon buttons, the composer field, the send button, map controls and the grabber.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating layers: map controls, menus, popovers, dialogs and toasts. Soft, short and low.

tokens.name: shadow-popup
tokens.usage: Every pop-up: menus, select lists, popovers (the comparison panel, the map key), dialogs and the Agents sheet. Deeper than shadow-float, so a pop-up stands clear of the page. In dark it adds a faint rim.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The review sheet, cast up over the map.

tokens.name: shadow-strata
tokens.usage: A changed glass map card: a top highlight and a soft lift. Unchanged cards keep only the highlight of their rim.

tokens.name: shadow-agent
tokens.usage: The card where an agent works: the lift of a changed card plus a faint accent halo around its accent edge.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Large glass: the map frame and the sheet. A top highlight and a deep, soft shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: A frosted button, chip, open tab or selected segment: a soft top highlight, a faint inner rim and a small shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-groove
tokens.usage: A groove: the track of tabs and segments, and a text field.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: The minimum size of every touch target, also map cards and icon buttons.

tokens.name: control-fine
tokens.usage: Control height on a fine pointer (desktop) only. The hit area stays 44px on touch.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, tabs and rows.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside a caption or a card's count line.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The longest line of reading text (Ask answers, notes).

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Cards and edges outside the selection and its neighbours.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls, with the disabled attribute and a reason nearby.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: The frost of large glass: the map frame, the sheet and the composer. With saturate(180%).

tokens.name: blur-card
tokens.usage: The frost of a map card, so lines behind it blur. With saturate(170%).

tokens.name: z-map
tokens.usage: The map canvas.

tokens.name: z-controls
tokens.usage: Map controls and the time rail.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: The review sheet.

tokens.name: z-composer
tokens.usage: The composer above the sheet.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the key.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs and their scrim.
